title: 400 errors after switching from Claude Haiku 4.5 to claude-haiku-5-5 with budget_tokens, temperature, top_k, or prefill
symptoms: 400 invalid_request_error after changing model to claude-haiku-5-5
Request with thinking budget_tokens is rejected
Request with temperature, top_p, or top_k is rejected
Request ending with an assistant prefill message is rejected
cause: Claude Haiku 5.5 (launched 2026-10-07) rejects manual extended thinking via budget_tokens, the sampling parameters temperature, top_p and top_k, assistant message prefill, and the computer_20250124 tool. Thinking blocks sent back after a change to system, tools, or earlier turns can also return 400. Adaptive thinking is on by default.
fix: Remove budget_tokens and use adaptive thinking with the effort parameter. Drop temperature, top_p, and top_k. Remove the trailing assistant prefill message and steer format through the prompt or structured outputs. Use computer_toolset_20260801 on the Claude API and Google Cloud, or computer_20251124 on Amazon Bedrock. Do not replay thinking blocks after editing earlier context.
apply: model: "claude-haiku-5-5"; remove: temperature, top_p, top_k, thinking.budget_tokens, trailing assistant message; computer tool: {"type":"computer_toolset_20260801"}
affected: claude-haiku-5-5, launched 2026-10-07, when migrating from Claude Haiku 4.5
